method: Rolling split conformal: finite-sample 90% quantile of absolute out-of-sample errors in the trailing 180 days, per horizon; lower bound at zero
residual_stream: Yearly chronological refits 2024-2026 (fit through the prior year)
operational: Each refresh recomputes widths from the trailing window, adding scored live forecasts to the retrospective stream
limitations: Serial dependence and nonstationarity rule out a guaranteed coverage; the window adapts, it does not certify
Retrospective errors come from yearly refits, while the live model is refit each run
Live interval coverage is reported separately once forecasts are scored
